hook: An AI teammate that lives in Slack or Teams 🤖
summary: Viktor joins your Slack or Microsoft Teams workspace, logs into the tools you connect (CRMs, Linear, Jira, GitHub, ad platforms and 9,800+ more) and hands back finished work: summaries, CRM follow-ups, reports and dashboards.
points: Free start with up to $100 in credits, no card
Team plan: $100 a month per workspace, not per seat (40,000 credits)
Asks for approval before significant changes
caveat: Credit use varies with task complexity, so monthly spend is harder to predict. Works only inside Slack or Teams.
